list: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list: 55 trophies (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze), 0 online

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. There is no online trophy and no DLC requirement: one playthrough covers the story, and free-roam after the story leaves everything for the 100% Completion Checklist still reachable. PowerPyx rates the set 4/10 and about 200 hours, with A Long Road (100% completion) the hardest single trophy.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Finish the story (Chapters 1-5) and grab the one-time moments on the way.
Work the 100% Completion Checklist after the story.
Clean up strands, activities, collectibles and crime trophies in free-roam.

trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing, the first mission of the game. It unlocks by playing through the opening: follow Jason and Lucia's introduction to Leonida and finish the mission's objectives. Because GTA VI has no mission replay, a story mission cannot be redone later, so do not rush past it.
trophies.missableNote: One-time story moment. There is no mission replay, so the opening mission can only be played once — finish it when it comes.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission Gone Fishing.
Follow the on-screen objectives to the end of the mission.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 of the story. Play through the chapter's missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter ends. While you are in Chapter 1, meditate at the spot at Jason's house: PowerPyx flags it as the one missable meditation for Positive Mental Attitude, so do it before the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play Chapter 1 missions in order.
Before leaving Chapter 1, meditate at Jason's house for Positive Mental Attitude.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 of the story. Keep playing the main missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter ends. There is nothing extra to do for this one — it is a pure story-progress trophy.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play Chapter 2 missions in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 of the story. Play the main missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter ends. Use the time between missions to scan vehicles and study animals with the binoculars — that progress counts toward the 100% Completion Checklist later.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play Chapter 3 missions in order.
Scan vehicles and study animals as you travel, for the 100% checklist.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 of the story. Play the main missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter ends. You are one chapter from the finale now, so it is a good moment to finish any open stranger strands before the story moves on.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play Chapter 4 missions in order.
Clear open stranger strands before the finale if you can.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. This is the gold trophy for finishing the game: play through Chapter 5 to its last mission and complete it. After the story you return to free-roam, and the 100% Completion Checklist unlocks under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Play the final chapter's missions in order.
Complete the final mission.
After the story, open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion to start the checklist phase.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission: play the main missions in order until it appears, then finish its objectives. The trophy pops when the mission completes.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play story missions until Breakfast Run appears.
Complete the mission's objectives.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story mission: play the main missions in order until it appears, then finish the heist. Plan the approach the mission offers and complete its objectives to pop the trophy.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play story missions until The Cartel Heist appears.
Complete the heist's objectives.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. It is a story mission: play the main missions in order until it appears, then finish its objectives. The trophy pops when the mission completes.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Play story missions until Child's Play appears.
Complete the mission's objectives.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. It is a story mission: play the main missions in order until it appears, then finish its objectives. The trophy pops when the mission completes.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Play story missions until Headliners appears.
Complete the mission's objectives.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. It is a story mission: play the main missions in order until it appears, then finish its objectives. The trophy pops when the mission completes.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Play story missions until VCIA Takedown appears.
Complete the mission's objectives.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a story mission: play the main missions in order until it appears, then finish its objectives. The trophy pops when the mission completes.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Play story missions until Operation Savage Glory appears.
Complete the mission's objectives.

trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. After the story, the 100% Completion Checklist unlocks under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. PowerPyx calls it the hardest trophy, but the thresholds are lenient: it is closer to 60% of true game completion. You need 70 of 80 Challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, and the full robberies, shooting ranges, drone races, underwater discoveries and Bret's quests. Most of it comes from doing the other trophies.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story to unlock the checklist (Progress, Stats, 100% Completion).
Work the checklist: 70 of 80 Challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, all robberies, ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
The gold pops when the checklist hits 100%.

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near-misses, drifts and airtime tricks while driving or riding: chain them in free-roam and the counter climbs. It is a grind, so fold it into travelling between missions and checklist tasks rather than farming it in one sitting.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Drive and ride everywhere instead of fast-travelling.
Jump ramps, drift corners and thread near-misses to bank stunts.
Keep going until the counter reaches 250.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are 9 activity types in Leonida: sample one of each — a race, a shooting range challenge, a fishing challenge, an arcade game, bowling, a Top Fun drone race, and the rest — and the trophy pops when the ninth type is tried. Use the map's activity icons to find them.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open the map and find the activity icons across Leonida.
Play one of each of the 9 activity types.
The trophy pops when the ninth type is tried.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The ranges test accuracy and speed across weapon types: learn each range's target pattern, steady your aim, and replay a challenge until the gold threshold clears. The gold medals are not too difficult, and the full set is also required for the 100% Completion Checklist.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit a Shooting Range and open its challenge list.
Work through all 42 challenges, replaying each until gold.
The silver pops when the last challenge turns gold.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 drone race locations with 42 races between them: win at least one race at each of the 14 spots. Fly the gates cleanly — smooth lines beat raw speed — and replay a location until you win there.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find the Top Fun drone race spots on the map (14 locations).
Win at least one race at each location.
The trophy pops when all 14 locations have a win.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Races count per event, so win 20 distinct race events across Leonida — street races, off-road and the rest. Pick a fast, stable car for the class, learn each route once, and move on to the next event.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Find race events on the map.
Win 20 different race events.
The trophy pops on the 20th distinct win.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot, take his challenge, and out-fish him: watch the line tension, reel in the window, and land the bigger catch. If you lose, challenge him again — the trophy only needs one win.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Find Cal at a fishing spot and take his challenge.
Mind line tension and reel in the window.
Beat his catch once to pop the trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet in Leonida, start a game, and play it through to completion. Any arcade game counts — pick the one you find first and finish a full run.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in Leonida.
Start a game and play it through to the end.
The trophy pops when the game completes.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy, one of the strangers with a mission strand. Stranger strands appear as icons on the map: work through Andy's missions in order until his finale. Because there is no mission replay, a strand's finale can only be played once, so finish it when it appears.
trophies.missableNote: One-time strand finale. There is no mission replay, so Andy's last mission can only be played once — finish the strand when its finale appears.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Find Andy's strand icon on the map.
Play Andy's missions in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton, one of the strangers with a mission strand. Work through Kenton's missions in order until his finale appears. Because there is no mission replay, a strand's finale can only be played once, so finish it when it appears.
trophies.missableNote: One-time strand finale. There is no mission replay, so Kenton's last mission can only be played once — finish the strand when its finale appears.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Find Kenton's strand icon on the map.
Play Kenton's missions in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy, one of the strangers with a mission strand. Work through Billy's missions in order until his finale appears. Because there is no mission replay, a strand's finale can only be played once, so finish it when it appears.
trophies.missableNote: One-time strand finale. There is no mission replay, so Billy's last mission can only be played once — finish the strand when its finale appears.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Find Billy's strand icon on the map.
Play Billy's missions in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Stranger strands appear as icons on the map: pick up a stranger's missions and play each strand to its finale. You need 8 finished strands, so work through the strangers you meet — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and the rest — until the eighth finale completes.
trophies.missableNote: Needs 8 finished strands, and each strand's finale is a one-time mission with no replay. Finish every strand finale when it appears, or the eighth strand may never complete.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Pick up stranger strands from the map icons.
Play each strand to its finale.
The silver pops when the eighth strand completes.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy, one of the strangers with a mission strand. Work through Randy's missions in order until his finale appears. Because there is no mission replay, a strand's finale can only be played once, so finish it when it appears.
trophies.missableNote: One-time strand finale. There is no mission replay, so Randy's last mission can only be played once — finish the strand when its finale appears.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Find Randy's strand icon on the map.
Play Randy's missions in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone, one of the strangers with a mission strand. Work through Tyrone's missions in order until his finale appears. Because there is no mission replay, a strand's finale can only be played once, so finish it when it appears.
trophies.missableNote: One-time strand finale. There is no mission replay, so Tyrone's last mission can only be played once — finish the strand when its finale appears.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Find Tyrone's strand icon on the map.
Play Tyrone's missions in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in all. This is the one trophy PowerPyx confirms as potentially missable: the first meditation, at Jason's house, is missable in Chapter 1, so meditate there before the chapter closes. After that, find the remaining spots across Leonida and meditate at each one; the trophy pops at the last spot.
trophies.missableNote: CONFIRMED missable (PowerPyx): the first meditation, at Jason's house, is missable in Chapter 1. Meditate there before Chapter 1 ends, then find the other 17 spots.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: In Chapter 1, meditate at the spot at Jason's house — before the chapter ends.
Find the remaining 17 meditation spots across Leonida.
Meditate at the last spot to pop the trophy.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret, one of the strangers. Bret's strand is about hunting: follow his missions until he asks for a specific unique animal, track it, and take it down. Bret's quests are also one of the sets the 100% Completion Checklist requires in full, so finish his strand properly.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Find Bret's strand and play his missions.
When he names the unique animal, track it down.
Hunt the animal to complete the request.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card sets holding 480 unique cards across Leonida: collect every card of a set to complete it, and do that for 3 sets. Cards turn up in the world and in shops — check the Progress Database under Map, Progress to see which sets you are close to finishing.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collect cards across Leonida (18 sets, 480 cards).
Complete one full set, then two more.
The silver pops when the third set completes.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK spots are marked across Leonida: visit each one and use the WAiNK interaction there. Work through the map region by region and the counter climbs to 100 — it is a long collectible hunt, so fold it into travelling for other trophies.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Find WAiNK spots on the map.
Use WAiNK It at each spot you visit.
Keep going until the counter reaches 100.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 Challenges in 8 categories of 10: pick the ones that suit you and complete any 50. You only need 70 of 80 for the 100% Completion Checklist, so the hardest ones can be skipped — do the easy categories first and the trophy pops at 50.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open the Challenges list (8 categories, 10 each).
Complete the easiest challenges first.
The trophy pops at 50 completed.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the heat dies. A fast car and the back roads out of the city help; do not let the cops re-spot you.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Bring your partner along, then build a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight and leave the search area.
Stay hidden until the wanted level clears.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Bring your partner, hit three shops in a row, and keep the wanted level the whole time — do not let it clear between robberies, and do not let it spike out of control. Plan a route with three close shops, rob fast, and keep moving.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Bring your partner and pick three shops close together.
Rob the first shop, then go straight to the second and third.
Keep your wanted level the whole time — do not let it clear between robberies.
The trophy pops after the third shop.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning vehicles with the binoculars discovers them: you need 100 discovered for this trophy. PowerPyx notes the 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so keep scanning as you travel — the same habit covers both.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Carry the binoculars and scan vehicles as you travel.
Discover 100 different vehicles.
Keep scanning toward 200 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus slows time and lets you pick targets: trigger it with a group of enemies close together, mark five of them, and take them all down before the focus ends. Pick a crowded fight so five targets are in range at once.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a fight with five or more enemies close together.
Trigger Combat Focus.
Take down 5 enemies before the focus ends.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. This is a one-time scripted moment at the airport: when the story takes you to VCIA, leave in an unscheduled way instead of following the normal departure. Because there is no mission replay, you cannot come back to it later — make the departure when the moment arrives.
trophies.missableNote: One-time story moment. There is no mission replay, so the VCIA departure can only be made once — make the unscheduled departure when the moment arrives.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Play the story until the VCIA moment arrives.
Make the unscheduled departure instead of the normal one.
The trophy pops when the departure is made.

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The Rhino is the tank: get into a Rhino and cause chaos — or attract a Rhino's attention — in a high-heat situation. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed by the guide sites, so take a Rhino out in a wanted-level shootout and the trophy should pop on the chaos that follows.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Find a Rhino tank in a high-heat situation.
Use it in a wanted-level shootout.
The trophy pops on the Rhino chaos.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan it quiet: case the store, go in when the staff are not watching, smash the cases fast and slip out before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, that robbery does not count — treat each attempt as one shot and plan the route out before you go in.
trophies.missableNote: One-shot per attempt: if you are detected, that robbery does not count. Plan it quiet and slip out unseen.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Pick a jewelry store and plan the route out first.
Go in quiet and smash the cases fast.
Slip out without being detected to complete the robbery.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults are the big scores: rob five of them and escape each time. Plan the approach, crack the vault, grab the cash and get out before the police lock the area down. This is a silver trophy, so expect the vaults to be the toughest robberies in the game.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Find a bank vault and plan the approach.
Rob the vault and escape the police.
Repeat for 5 bank vaults — the silver pops on the fifth escape.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, crack it open and take the cash, then escape the police. A heavy vehicle helps to stop the truck, and a fast getaway car helps to lose the heat.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on the road.
Stop it and crack it open.
Take the cash and escape the police.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas in all. Drive and fly through every named area until the map fills in: the Progress Database under Map, Progress shows which areas you have visited. Work region by region — Vice City, the Keys, Mount Kalaga, Port Gellhorn and the rest — until all 52 are marked explored.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Open Map, Progress to see unvisited areas.
Travel through every named area of Leonida.
The trophy pops when all 52 areas are explored.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — one operation per gang, all 9 gangs across Leonida. Gang operations are marked across the map: hit one operation per gang and the trophy pops. Plan the approach, rob the stash, and escape — then move on to the next gang's operation.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find a gang operation on the map.
Rob the operation and escape.
Repeat for all 9 gangs.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a beach bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take it in with the view. Any beach bar on Ocean Beach works — it is a small, relaxing trophy to grab between missions.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Find a beach bar on Ocean Beach.
Order a cocktail there.
The trophy pops when you enjoy it with the view.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. During a showroom visit, smash your way out through the glass instead of driving out normally. This is a one-time scripted moment, so do it when the showroom scene comes — there is no way to redo it later.
trophies.missableNote: One-time scripted moment. The showroom smash can only happen during that showroom scene — smash out when it comes; there is no redo.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Visit a vehicle showroom.
During the showroom scene, smash your way out through the glass.
The trophy pops when you break out in style.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and play a full game with proper follow-through: aim for the pocket, watch the power and spin, and finish the game. The trophy is about playing the game at that alley, so complete a game there.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Start a game and play it through.
The trophy pops when the game completes.

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Jason and Lucia are a partnership: build it up by doing things together — missions, activities and free-roam time as a pair. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed by the guide sites, so keep playing together and the trophy pops when the partnership reaches its milestone.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Play missions and activities with your partner.
Spend free-roam time together as a pair.
The trophy pops when the partnership milestone is reached.

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). The game tracks the choices you make as you play — dialogue choices, approach choices, and moral calls in missions. Keep making choices whenever the game offers them; the in-game tracker counts them toward the trophy. Because the choices only come up while playing, this one fills in naturally across a full playthrough.
trophies.missableNote: One-time choices. Some choices only appear once during the story, with no mission replay — make a choice whenever the game offers one, or it may never come again.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Make a choice whenever the game offers one.
Keep choosing through missions and story moments.
The trophy pops when the tracked choices reach the target.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This trophy is about succeeding on a second try: fail something once, then succeed on the retry. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed by the guide sites, so play through the story and side content and watch for a moment where a second attempt lands. This entry will be updated when the trigger is confirmed.
trophies.missableNote: A second-try moment: the trophy is about the second attempt landing. If a second try comes up, take it — it may not come around again.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Play through the story and side content.
If something fails once, try it again.
Succeed on the second try to pop the trophy.

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? This points to a strange event somewhere in Leonida — a weird encounter in the world. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed by the guide sites, so explore off the beaten path: remote places, odd hours, and strange landmarks are where Leonida hides its secrets. This entry will be updated when the trigger is confirmed.
trophies.missableNote: One-time strange event. If a strange event triggers in the world, it may only happen once — stay and see it through, or it may be gone.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore remote and unusual places in Leonida.
Visit strange landmarks at odd hours.
See a strange event through to its end.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. A melee drive-by means hitting someone with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle: drive past a target, swing the melee weapon from the car, and knock them over. Pick a slow, straight stretch with a target close to the road, and line the swing up as you pass.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle.
Drive past a target and swing the melee weapon from the car.
Knock the target over to pop the trophy.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and crime: take them to your contacts and launder them in batches until the total earned reaches $250,000. It is a long economy grind, so fold it into your crime cleanup — rob, launder, repeat.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies and crime.
Launder them through your contacts.
Keep going until $250,000 is laundered.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy from every kind of shop in Leonida — clothes, weapons, cars, food — until the total spent hits $100,000. The expensive items count more, so buy the pricey pieces first and the trophy pops when the spending total is reached.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Visit shops across Leonida.
Buy items, starting with the expensive ones.
The trophy pops when $100,000 is spent.

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 in all. Garages are for sale across Leonida: buy each one to store your vehicles. They cost money, so save up from missions and robberies, then work through the property list until all 8 are yours.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Save money from missions and robberies.
Find garage properties for sale across Leonida.
Buy all 8 garages.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app on your phone, find vehicles to register, and add 10 of them. The vehicles you own and drive count — register them as you collect them until the tenth is in.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app on your phone.
Register vehicles you own or drive.
The trophy pops at the tenth registration.
